The Bright Side:
The public infighting forces right-wing figures to openly confront and disavow overt bigotry within their networks.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHO (principled moral actors) with WHAT (tactical factional positioning and social media engagement warfare).

Social Physics Analysis:
By trading insults and deploying racial tropes, both actors leverage outrage economics to capture attention at the expense of social cohesion.

The Trajectory: The Path of Destruction.
When you map the gap between stated party reform and actual vitriolic attacks, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Evil.

The Unavoidable Truth: Public political figures frequently amplify inflammatory language to drive algorithmic engagement and tribal loyalty.

The Unavoidable Lie: These feuds represent genuine moral reckonings rather than strategic brand positioning.
